sources.title: Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Amendment Regulations, 2022: revised Schedule I
sources.qualification: Authoritative Gazette amendment. English Schedule I rows 10, 13 and 14 supply the selected fibre, total sugars and sodium numerical criteria. PDF page numbers are one-based.

sources.title: Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018: general requirements and non-addition claims
sources.qualification: Principal Gazette regulations provide general applicability and advertising requirements; regulation 6(1) concerns no-added-sugar claims. This numerical engine does not establish full regulatory compliance.

sources.title: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Regulations compendium, version IV, 14 December 2022
sources.qualification: Convenience cross-check of the principal regulations and amendments; the Gazette is the legal authority. This repository stores reviewed metadata and threshold facts, not redistributed PDFs.
